statement: Moving a message-group replica can never leave the group permanently leaderless. Four latent mechanisms compose into an unrecoverable leaderless group once a leader replica is relocated (classified 2026-09-28 on the replica-lifecycle-durable-generation candidate, where an activation-CAS regression exposed them; evidence session scratchpad mg-livelock/): (1) MessageGroupAssignment.findMovableReplica (src/bootstrap/message-group-assignment.js:271-276) takes leadership from the copied SERVICES.raft_role, and the role publisher always writes follower over a leader row (message-group-service-leadership-state-runtime-methods.js:99 collapseLeaderToFollower), so the chooser's authority is an advisory copy; (2) MG MOVE_REPLICA source release is a plain localService.shutdown() with no role check or typed leadership handoff (src/bootstrap/owners/move-replica-handoff-owner.js:458-496), unlike the partition REPLACE_SOURCE_LEADER_HANDOFF path; (3) the moved replica keeps its own source address as a voter (bootstrap-join-admission-owner.js:662-665 peerAddresses; reconcileRaftPeersFromCache skips local replicas), a phantom voter that raises the majority beyond reach; (4) a replica joining an existing group denies every vote and suppresses its election timer until its node is READY (message-group-service-inbound-ingress-runtime-methods.js:144-149, node-joining-admission-readiness.js:243), which can deadlock against a leaderless group; per-index election jitter (2500 ms per replica index, replica-election-timeouts.js) makes the most up-to-date survivor the slowest to stand. Repair as one owner class: the chooser reads authoritative Raft leadership; MOVE_REPLICA of the current leader requires a typed leadership handoff before destructive movement; voter sets are built from replica identities so a moved replica cannot retain a phantom voter; JOINING-node voting policy cannot permanently prevent election after legitimate movement.

constraints.statement: The four mechanisms are one message-group/Raft safety class and are repaired together at their owners, not as four local patches.
Leadership and voter membership come from the Raft owner (committed ConfState, live role), never from SERVICES copies.
No timeout, budget, jitter or retry change is the repair; witnesses are deterministic and red-on-revert.
Separate from replica-lifecycle-durable-generation, which repairs only its own activation-generation regression and must not depend on this quest.
